title: A Postcard for the Bakery
author: Quentin Thackeray
blurb: Mirabel Ravensworth, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
